# Trusted Advisors

> A Tokyo-based financial advisory and consulting firm specializing in M&A, corporate finance, and cross-border transactions.

Trusted Advisors Co., Ltd provides comprehensive advisory services including M&A advisory, CFO support, financial advisory services (FAS), management buyouts (MBO), and valuation services. The firm serves clients in Japan and internationally, with expertise in cross-border business transactions and corporate restructuring.

## Key Topics

- M&A Advisory
- CFO Support
- Financial Advisory Services (FAS)
- Management Buyout (MBO)
- Valuation
- Due Diligence
- Cross-border Transactions
- Corporate Finance
- Business Restructuring
- Real Estate Advisory
- IFRS
- Japan
- Tokyo Headquarters
- Trusted Advisors Co., Ltd
- Taisuke Mizuno
